'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Believe it or not, my business has taken off, and it's going strong! I'm thinking of expanding again. Help me out again, yes-yes?}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 100 [[Rogues]]
* Hand over 50 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] LBT brand equipment

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* 1× [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Coyote Tan)]]

====BEAR Exclusive====
* Unlocks barter for [[FORT Redut-M body armor]] at [[Ragman]] LL4
* Unlocks purchase of [[BEAR OPS MGS Black]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL3
* Unlocks purchase of [[BEAR URON Coyote]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL3

====USEC Exclusive====
* Unlocks purchase of [[IOTV Gen4 body armor (High Mobility Kit, MultiCam)]] at [[Ref]] LL4
* Unlocks purchase of [[USEC BOSS Delta MC]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL3
* Unlocks purchase of [[USEC Defender WG]] clothing at [[Ragman]] LL3

{{quote|Uhh, you want your cut? Here's the thing, brother, it's kinda not an option, you know? Better yet, look at this new drip I'm offering now!}}
